remarks: Welcome to urban sophistication and modern comfort at 97 Richards Ave Unit B7 in vibrant Norwalk, CT. This stylish condominium offers an inviting retreat with 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, and 1196 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The spacious living area provides a versatile canvas, and is a perfect space for entertaining while the large deck offers a place to relax while enjoying the views. The well-appointed kitchen is sure to inspire culinary creativity. Retreat to the comfort of the primary suite, featuring a serene ambiance and a private en-suite bath for your convenience. A second bedroom offers versatility as a guest room, home office, or personal sanctuary, accommodating your unique lifestyle needs. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry facilities and ample storage space. Nestled in the heart of Norwalk, this condominium presents a prime opportunity to embrace city living at its finest. Explore nearby dining, shopping, and entertainment options, immersing yourself in the vibrant culture and energy of the community.
